tempo is the one a tempo-synced clip is marked with. Taken as it is, not rounded.

range.description: The part of the song to separate alone. Set with POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/range once the song is in the queue: refused when a job is created. Separated alone only when the separate_selection setting is on when the song runs; otherwise the whole song is.

JobRange.description:
A part of a song, chosen in the trimmer while the song waits in the queue. With the
separate_selection setting on when the song runs, only that part is separated, as a
song of its own named "<song> (<label>)".

end.description: Where it ends, in seconds into the song.
end.title: End

label.description: The part named as a clip of it is: "bars 9-16", "9.3-11.2" or "0m21.40s-0m33.10s". Named again whenever the tempo or bar 1 of the job changes.
label.title: Label

start.description: Where the part starts, in seconds into the song.
start.title: Start

start.description: Where the part starts, in seconds into the song.

post.description:
Write a stretch of a song as files to drag into a DAW: of the song's own file,
or of its stems, summed into one file or one file each. A clip that is already
written is found again. A file of its name that is newer than the song's stems or
file is never written over: when it holds something else, the clip takes the name
with "(2)", "(3)" and so on.

get.description: Serve an output file. Supports HTTP range requests for audio.

post.description: Start every job that is waiting for the user's Start.

Set a job's tempo, key and bar 1 by hand: before it runs, or on its finished
stems.

Name a job's song, or give it its file's name back with null. Every job of the
same file follows. One that waits keeps the name for its run; stems that are
written are renamed on the disk, their folder and their files. Refused while the
song is being separated.

Choose the part of a waiting song to separate alone, or take it away again with
null. Only that part is separated when the separate_selection setting is on when
the song starts; otherwise the whole song is. Refused once the song has started.
Start one job that is waiting for the user's Start.

get.description: Songs being fetched from links, and the ones whose fetch failed.

post.description: Fetch the song behind a link. Once it is here it is queued like a dropped file.

delete.description: Cancel a fetch that is under way, or dismiss one that failed.

post.description: Write some of a song's stems as one file, next to them.

get.description: The peaks JSON written next to a stem.

post.description: Compare the GPU with the CPU. Takes a minute or two; refused while a job runs.

A song's own file, ready to play and draw before it is separated, with the beat
grid detection finds. The first request for a song takes a few seconds.
Set the tempo, key and bar 1 of a song's finished stems by hand.

Hide stems of a song from the app's lists, keep empty ones in them, or take
either choice away. Kept in the manifest: every file stays where it is.

Name the song of finished stems, or give it its file's name back with null.
Its folder and its stem files are renamed, for every recipe it was separated
with. Resolves with the stem set where it is now.
